attempt_notes.result: copytree stalled on shared-filesystem reads after SSH command timed out; stopped the owned copy process and preserved its partial directory. Extracting the original source archive and applying the reviewed delta instead.

Build succeeded. aligned_overlap, lower_overlap, failed_open and cache_hit passed before insert_failure terminated: a NULL pgtable directory allocator is fatal in UCX, not a returned allocation error. Replaced that injection with a conflicting region inserted by the mock driver after successful import; it exercises the UCS_ERR_ALREADY_EXISTS cleanup path. Prior logs retained.

interpretation: The six deterministic overlap tests and six existing LRU tests run with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty. Only open/close operations are mocked; the production cache lock, page table, invalidation, purge, accounting and insertion-failure cleanup execute.

The baseline-order control replaces only the cache insertion routine with its pre-fix form, adapted to the same open/close operations table. Its lower-overlap test fails because import precedes close even when the mock import succeeds. This is a controlled baseline, not a separate unmodified upstream build.

Removing insertion-failure close or the full-cache purge makes its corresponding test fail. The purge test includes an unrelated referenced mapping. These negative outcomes are expected and preserved.

The real GPU regression executable is the previously built 2bb888a standalone UCT test, used here as external validation after replacing it in-tree with deterministic gtests. Its binary hash is recorded; each process library map is audited against this build prefix.

Normal native MPI and direct UCT runs verify data and 30 lower-start overlaps. The baseline-order runtime recovers 30 CUDA error-208 imports per program; the candidate has none. Baseline regression failure is expected.

The candidate runtime is restored before final acceptance. These checks do not establish Fabric/POSIX-FD hardware behavior, concurrent allocation/free safety, full upstream CI completion, or application/performance acceptance.

scripts.build.sh:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
ucx_validation_root=$PWD
cd source
./autogen.sh > ../logs/autogen.log 2>&1
cd "$ucx_validation_root"
mkdir build
cd build
../source/contrib/configure-devel --prefix="$ucx_validation_root/install/candidate" \
    --without-go --without-java --without-rocm --with-mpi --disable-static \
    --with-cuda=/opt/devtools/nvidia/cuda-12.9.1 --with-gdrcopy=/usr \
    CC=/usr/bin/gcc CXX=/usr/bin/g++ CFLAGS='-O1 -g' CXXFLAGS='-O1 -g' \
    > ../logs/configure.log 2>&1
ucx_link_flags="-Wl,-rpath-link,$PWD/src/ucp/.libs -Wl,-rpath-link,$PWD/src/uct/.libs -Wl,-rpath-link,$PWD/src/ucs/.libs -Wl,-rpath-link,$PWD/src/ucm/.libs"
make -j16 LDFLAGS="$ucx_link_flags" > ../logs/build.log 2>&1
make install LDFLAGS="$ucx_link_flags" > ../logs/install.log 2>&1
cd "$ucx_validation_root"
cc -shared -fPIC -O2 -g -I/opt/devtools/nvidia/cuda-12.9.1/include ipc_trace.c -ldl -pthread -o ipc_trace.so
mpicc -O2 -g -I/opt/devtools/nvidia/cuda-12.9.1/include mpi_repro.c -L/opt/devtools/nvidia/cuda-12.9.1/lib64 -lcudart -o mpi_repro

from pathlib import Path
import collections
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, '/org/org-open-sai/proj-sai-hpc-software/ucx-ipc-20261110-a/control')
from suite import node_info
node_info(root / 'runs', 4)
report = {'job': os.environ['SLURM_JOB_ID'], 'cases': [], 'phases': {}}
source = root / 'source/src/uct/cuda/cuda_ipc/cuda_ipc_cache.c'
candidate = source.read_text()
hashes = json.loads((root / 'source-hashes.json').read_text())
for name, digest in hashes.items():
    assert hashlib.sha256((root / 'source' / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == digest, name
report['source_sha256'] = hashes

def record():
    (root / 'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')

def run(name, command, env=None, expected=0):
    log = root / 'logs' / (name + '.log')
    with log.open('w') as stream:
        result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=root, env=env, stdout=stream, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    text = log.read_text(errors='replace')
    item = {'name': name, 'command': command, 'exit_code': result.returncode,
            'expected': expected, 'log': str(log.relative_to(root))}
    item['accepted'] = result.returncode == expected
    report['cases'].append(item)
    record()
    print(json.dumps(item), flush=True)
    assert item['accepted'], text[-4000:]
    return text, item

def phase(name):
    report['phases'][name] = {
        'cache_source_sha256': hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        'cuda_module_sha256': hashlib.sha256((root / 'install/candidate/lib/ucx/libuct_cuda.so.0.0.0').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    }
    record()

def rebuild(name, text):
    source.write_text(text)
    run(name + '-build', ['make', '-C', str(root / 'build/src/uct/cuda'), '-j8'])
    run(name + '-install', ['make', '-C', str(root / 'build/src/uct/cuda'), 'install'])
    phase(name)

def gtest(name, filter, expected=0, repeat=1):
    env = os.environ.copy()
    env['CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES'] = ''
    env['UCX_HANDLE_ERRORS'] = 'bt'
    text, item = run(name, ['timeout', '180', 'make', '-C', str(root / 'build/test/gtest'),
                    'test', 'GTEST_FILTER=' + filter,
                    'GTEST_EXTRA_ARGS=--gtest_shuffle --gtest_random_seed=2026 --gtest_repeat=' + str(repeat)],
                    env=env, expected=expected)
    item['gpu_visibility'] = ''
    item['passed'] = len(re.findall(r'^\[       OK \]', text, re.M))
    item['failed'] = re.findall(r'^\[  FAILED  \] (test_cuda_ipc_cache_\S+)', text, re.M)
    assert '[  SKIPPED ]' not in text, text[-4000:]
    if expected == 0:
        assert item['passed'] >= 6 * repeat, item
        assert not item['failed'], item
    else:
        assert item['failed'], text[-4000:]
    record()

def hardware(name, mode, expected=0, errors=0):
    case = root / 'runs' / name
    (case / 'trace').mkdir(parents=True)
    executable = {
        'normal': root.parent / 'ucx-review-probe-20261113/build-candidate/test/mpi/.libs/test_cuda_ipc_overlap',
        'native': root / 'mpi_repro',
        'mpi-matrix': root / 'build/test/mpi/.libs/test_mpi_cuda'
    }[mode]
    cmd = ['timeout', '--kill-after=10', '180', 'mpirun', '-np', '2', '--bind-to', 'none']
    if mode == 'normal':
        cmd += ['-mca', 'pml', 'ob1', '-mca', 'osc', '^ucx', '-mca', 'btl', 'tcp,self',
                '-mca', 'btl_tcp_if_include', 'lo', '-mca', 'coll', '^hcoll,ml,ucc']
    cmd += ['/usr/bin/python3', '-B', str(root / 'rank.py'), name, 'candidate', mode, str(executable)]
    text, item = run(name, cmd, expected=expected)
    item['executable_sha256'] = hashlib.sha256(executable.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    if mode == 'mpi-matrix':
        item['passed'] = len(re.findall(r': PASS', text))
        item['skipped'] = len(re.findall(r': SKIP', text))
        assert item['passed'] == 450 and item['skipped'] == 36 and ': FAIL' not in text, item
    elif mode == 'normal':
        assert f'lower overlaps=30, UCX errors/warnings={errors}; data checks passed' in text, text[-4000:]
    else:
        assert 'PASS exact data checks; lower_overlap_count=30' in text, text[-4000:]
    traces = list((case / 'trace').glob('ipc-r[01]-*.log'))
    assert len(traces) == 2, traces
    counts = collections.Counter()
    item['library_maps'] = []
    for trace in traces:
        content = trace.read_text()
        counts.update(re.findall(r'^\d+ open result=(\d+)\b', content, re.M))
        libs = sorted({line.split()[-1] for line in content.splitlines()
                       if line.startswith('MAP ') and re.search(r'/lib(?:ucs|ucp|uct|ucm)(?:[._])', line)})
        assert libs and all(lib.startswith(str(root / 'install/candidate') + '/') for lib in libs), libs
        item['library_maps'].append(libs)
    if mode != 'mpi-matrix':
        assert counts['0'] == 60 and counts['208'] == errors, counts
        assert sum(n for c, n in counts.items() if c != '0') == errors, counts
    item['driver_open_results'] = dict(counts)
    record()

phase('candidate')
gtest('candidate-gtest-no-gpu', 'test_cuda_ipc_cache_*', repeat=3)
start = candidate.index('ucs_status_t\nuct_cuda_ipc_cache_put_region(')
end = candidate.index('UCS_PROFILE_FUNC(ucs_status_t, uct_cuda_ipc_map_memhandle,', start)
baseline = candidate[:start] + (root / 'baseline-cache-put.c').read_text() + candidate[end:]
try:
    rebuild('baseline-order', baseline)
    gtest('baseline-order-negative', 'test_cuda_ipc_cache_overlap.lower_overlap', expected=2)
    hardware('baseline-regression', 'normal', expected=1, errors=30)
    hardware('baseline-native', 'native', errors=30)
    leak_anchor = '        cache->ops->close(region);\n        goto err_free_region;'
    assert candidate.count(leak_anchor) == 1
    rebuild('missing-close', candidate.replace(leak_anchor, '        goto err_free_region;'))
    gtest('missing-close-negative', 'test_cuda_ipc_cache_overlap.insert_failure', expected=2)
    purge_anchor = '            uct_cuda_ipc_cache_purge(cache, 1);'
    assert candidate.count(purge_anchor) == 1
    rebuild('missing-purge', candidate.replace(purge_anchor, '            /* mutation: omit purge */'))
    gtest('missing-purge-negative', 'test_cuda_ipc_cache_overlap.purge_retry', expected=2)
finally:
    rebuild('candidate-restored', candidate)
gtest('candidate-restored-no-gpu', 'test_cuda_ipc_cache_overlap.*')
hardware('candidate-regression', 'normal')
hardware('candidate-native', 'native')
hardware('candidate-mpi-matrix', 'mpi-matrix')
assert report['phases']['candidate']['cache_source_sha256'] == report['phases']['candidate-restored']['cache_source_sha256']
report['status'] = 'PASS'
record()
print('VALIDATION PASS', flush=True)
